messages:
marta: Quick triage - noticed inbound peak from webinar signups, some leads lost in enrichment causing rr starvation.

nate: Logs show enrichment queue spiked at 14:02 UTC, avg delay 48s. Our current rule waits for enrichment to finish before assignment which is the problem.

leo: Proposal: soft-assign immediately to rr-temp, include enrichment_id so we can patch owner record when enrichment completes. That way they show up in AE queue fast.

marta: Agree. New SLA tweak: if enrichment >25s, do soft-assign to rr-temp, escalate to VIP if enrichment later marks high-fit.

hubspot-bot: Workflow "webinar-soft-assign" updated by nate at 2026-03-20T15:12:05Z :white_check_mark:

nate: I'll add TTL for soft-assigns (2h) so stale temp owners return to pool. Also add dedupe on email and company domain.

leo: Good call. Also add audit note on contact record `soft_assign_reason=webinar_peak` so success ops can reconcile.

marta: I'll update the playbook and include an ops runbook for when enrichment lags during events.

nate: ETA for workflow change: 2 hours.

leo: I'll coordinate with growth to flag upcoming webinars so we can pre-warm enrichment workers.

marta: Thanks — let's monitor on the dashboard after deploy.
